papers.title: Biological evaluation of highly ordered TiO2 nanotubes produced on Ti6Al4V alloys manufactured via electron beam powder bed fusion (EB-PBF)
papers.abstract: This experimental work evaluates the biological activity of highly ordered TiO2 nanotubes produced on Ti6Al4V samples manufactured via electron beam powder bed fusion (EB-PBF) in longitudinal and cross orientation. The in vitro cytotoxicity assay shows that TiO2 nanotubes produced on EB-PBF in longitudinal and cross orientation showed non-cytotoxic activity with viability percentages exceeding 85% in L929 and MG-63 cell lines. Additionally, moderate ROS and NO production from RAW 264.7 murine macrophages confirm TiO2 nanotubes cytocompatibility. In cell adhesion assays, active living MG-63 cells with a strong green fluorescence signal, lamellipodia structures and mitotic rounded-cells, were seen in both TiO2 nanotubes produced on EB-PBF in longitudinal and cross orientation. From the results of our experimental work, there are no significant differences in the cellular behavior of TiO2 nanotubes produced on Ti6Al4V samples manufactured via electron beam powder bed fusion (EB-PBF) in longitudinal or cross orientation. The significance of this work lies in clarifying how an important processing variable in additive manufacturing build orientation impacts the biological performance of nanostructured implant surfaces.

llm.relevance_to_user: 论文关注的是生物活性评估，而非Ti-6Al-4V的力学或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: The paper evaluates biological activity (cytotoxicity, cell adhesion) of TiO2 nanotubes, not mechanical or fatigue properties of Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估EB-PBF制造Ti6Al4V合金上TiO2纳米管的生物活性。
summary_zh.method: 在纵向和横向样品上制备TiO2纳米管，进行体外细胞毒性、ROS/NO和细胞粘附实验。
summary_zh.result: TiO2纳米管显示出非细胞毒性，细胞活力>85%，并观察到良好的细胞粘附。
summary_zh.validation: 通过L929和MG-63细胞系以及RAW 264.7巨噬细胞进行体外实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: This work evaluates the biological activity of TiO2 nanotubes on EB-PBF Ti6Al4V alloys to determine their suitability for implant surfaces.
summary_en.method: TiO2 nanotubes were fabricated on longitudinal and cross-oriented EB-PBF Ti6Al4V samples, and in vitro cytotoxicity, ROS, NO production, and cell adhesion assays were performed.
summary_en.result: TiO2 nanotubes were non-cytotoxic with >85% viability, moderate ROS/NO levels, and active cell adhesion with lamellipodia and mitotic cells.
summary_en.validation: In vitro assays using L929, MG-63, and RAW 264.7 cell lines validated the cytocompatibility.

papers.title: Effect of the Annealing Treatment on the Microstructure and Properties of TC4 Titanium Alloy TIG and Laser-Welded Joints
papers.abstract: This study compares the microstructural evolution and mechanical properties of TC4 (Ti-6Al-4V) titanium alloy joints welded by Tungsten Inert Gas (TIG) and laser processes, following a post-weld annealing treatment at 650 °C for 2 h. Distinct microstructures were obtained: the TIG-welded joint developed a heterogeneous mixture of short-rod α and lamellar β, while the laser-welded joint formed a more homogeneous equiaxed α structure with uniformly distributed β-phase nanoparticles. Electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD) results confirmed that the annealing treatment significantly weakened the strong welding-induced texture and disrupted the epitaxial growth mode of columnar grains. Mechanical testing demonstrated that annealing improved the strength-toughness balance, but the extent and mechanism differed between the two processes. For the TIG-welded joint, the ultimate tensile strength slightly decreased, while elongation and impact toughness increased by 18% and 10.4%, respectively. In contrast, the laser-welded joint maintained its original strength while achieving greater improvements in ductility and toughness, with elongation and impact toughness increasing by 20% and 15.2%, respectively. This divergence is attributed to insufficient recrystallization and the persistence of residual coarse grains, limiting the TIG joint’s performance. However, in the laser-welded joint, the pinning effect of β-phase nanoparticles and associated grain refinement enhanced ductility without compromising strength.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是TC4钛合金焊接接头的退火处理，而非增材制造钛合金的后处理。
llm.why_not_core: The paper studies annealing of welded Ti-6Al-4V joints, not additive-manufactured Ti-6Al-4V, so it does not address the direction's focus on post-processing of AM material.

summary_zh.motivation: 对比TIG与激光焊接TC4钛合金接头在退火后的组织与性能差异。
summary_zh.method: 对TIG和激光焊接接头进行650°C/2h退火，采用EBSD和力学测试分析。
summary_zh.result: 退火后激光焊接接头延展性和韧性提升更显著，强度不减；TIG接头强度略降但韧性提升。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸、冲击实验和EBSD微观表征验证组织-性能关系。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the microstructural evolution and mechanical properties of TIG and laser-welded Ti-6Al-4V joints after post-weld annealing.
summary_en.method: Post-weld annealing at 650°C for 2 h was applied to both TIG and laser-welded joints, followed by EBSD and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Annealing improved ductility and toughness more significantly in laser-welded joints without strength loss, while TIG joints showed slight strength reduction but improved toughness.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation via tensile tests, impact tests, and EBSD microstructural analysis.

papers.title: Fatigue properties and influential factors of Ti-6Al-4V ELI titanium alloy used in deep-sea pressure hull structure

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究传统加工Ti-6Al-4V的疲劳性能，而非增材制造Ti-6Al-4V，与本方向不相关。
llm.why_not_core: Paper does not address additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V; it focuses on conventionally processed material for deep-sea pressure hull, lacking LPBF/SLM/EBM/DED context.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究深海耐压壳用Ti-6Al-4V的疲劳性能及影响因素
summary_zh.method: 通过实验测试和数据分析评估疲劳特性
summary_zh.result: 揭示了深海环境下的疲劳行为关键影响因素
summary_zh.validation: 基于实验数据验证疲劳模型

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the fatigue properties and key influencing factors of Ti-6Al-4V ELI for deep-sea pressure hull applications.
summary_en.method: Experimental fatigue testing combined with analysis of influential parameters.
summary_en.result: Identified critical factors affecting fatigue life in deep-sea environments.
